mapper.select: SELECT * FROM translation_values WHERE key_id = #{keyId} ORDER BY locale
SELECT * FROM translation_values ORDER BY key_id, locale
SELECT locale, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN is_translated THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS translated FROM translation_values GROUP BY locale
SELECT * FROM translation_values WHERE key_id = #{keyId} AND locale = #{locale}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO translation_values (id, key_id, locale, value, is_translated, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{keyId}, #{locale}, #{value}, #{isTranslated}, #{updatedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE translation_values SET key_id = #{keyId}, locale = #{locale}, value = #{value}, is_translated = #{isTranslated}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
